summary.name: SPIP
summary.one_liner: SPIP is a publication system for the Internet aimed at collaborative work, multilingual sites, and ease of use for web authors, released under GPL-3.0 and written in PHP.
use_cases: Building a simple website managed by non-technical authors
summary.what_it_does: The page is only a bot-protection interstitial from the git.spip.net server asking visitors to enable JavaScript and cookies and click a button. It shows no features of its own. The project details come from the awesome-selfhosted listing: SPIP is a publication system for the Internet, aimed at collaborative work, multilingual environments, and simplicity of use for web authors. Its source code is licensed GPL-3.0 and it is written in PHP.
notable: Designed for collaborative work by multiple authors
Emphasises simplicity of use for web authors
Licensed GPL-3.0 with source hosted on git.spip.net
caveats: The fetched page was a bot-protection challenge, so no feature details were verified from the page itself
Pricing and platform details come from the awesome-selfhosted listing, not the page
